subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should maintainers split this umbrella into separate core TUI startup, sessions_send channel routing, WeChat plugin/core routing, background-event isolation, and session-activity ordering items, and which owner boundary should own each slice?
rationale: The source evidence confirms unresolved core behavior, but the report crosses TUI defaults, Gateway sessions, external WeChat plugin ownership, sessions_send, and product-level activity semantics; automation cannot choose that boundary safely.

options.title: Split and route subproblems
options.body: Keep the existing narrower issues for activity ordering and sessions_send, then create focused maintainer-owned follow-ups for TUI default sessions, WeChat usage-family proof, and flood/deadlock isolation.

options.title: Keep one umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the parent tracker and require maintainer/live repro evidence before any implementation work starts.

options.title: Defer until live WeChat proof
options.body: Leave only the source-proven core slices active and wait for fresh redacted WeChat logs or a live repro before routing the plugin-boundary work.

recommendation.title: Split and route subproblems
recommendation.body: Keep the existing narrower issues for activity ordering and sessions_send, then create focused maintainer-owned follow-ups for TUI default sessions, WeChat usage-family proof, and flood/deadlock isolation.
